name: Zenith Fibres Limited
about: Zenith Fibres Limited manufactures and sells polypropylene (PP) staple fibres and PP yarn in India. It operates through Manmade Fibre and Renewable Energy segments. The company offers PP spun yarn; and generates electricity through wind turbines. It also exports its products. The company serves automotive, geotextiles, technical fibres, flooring coverings, and construction industries. Zenith Fibres Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Vadodara, India.
